description: Dramatic UI redesign of the main pages (dashboard, landing, login, app-layout) to align with bettertok.app (clean dashboard) and tik.tools (dark #0a0a0c, cyan, green neon) aesthetic. Full rewrites to make changes DRAMATIC and visible. Also ensure docker-compose.yml has correct configuration.
steps: 1. Rewrite artifacts/creatools/src/pages/dashboard.tsx - completely new layout: larger stat cards with animated counters and glow effects, bento grid layout with more visual hierarchy, add quick-action cards with hover animations, add a 'Battle AI BETA' promotion card, redesign the welcome banner with more dramatic gradient and floating particles, add live activity feed section

2. Rewrite artifacts/creatools/src/components/layout/app-layout.tsx - dramatic new sidebar: add animated gradient border on the left edge, add pulsing dots for active items, redesign the logo area with larger breathing animation, add a mini status bar at the bottom of sidebar showing online users count, redesign the top bar to be more minimal with frosted glass and neon accents, ensure the sidebar collapsed state looks premium

3. Rewrite artifacts/creatools/src/pages/landing.tsx - make the hero section more dramatic: larger typography, more animated orbs, add floating tech badges, add a live counter animation showing 'X streamers online now', redesign feature cards with gradient borders and hover glow effects, add animated tool ticker with more items, enhance testimonials with glassmorphism

4. Rewrite artifacts/creatools/src/pages/login.tsx - enhance with: more dramatic background animations (multiple gradient orbs), add particle effects in the background, larger more prominent logo, add animated social proof section on the right panel, enhance form inputs with neon focus states

5. Enhance artifacts/creatools/src/index.css - add new utility classes: .neon-pulse (pulsing neon border animation), .glass-sidebar (sidebar-specific glass effect), .card-hover-lift (dramatic hover with scale + glow), .text-glow-cyan, .text-glow-green, add new keyframes for more complex animations
6. Verify infra/docker-compose.yml has: environment NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0 on the api service, NO healthcheck directive anywhere, and is properly configured
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard has dramatic new design with animated stat cards, bento grid, Battle AI promo card
Sidebar has animated gradient edge, premium collapsed state, and neon active indicators
Landing page has more dramatic hero with larger typography and more animations
Login has enhanced background animations and neon focus states
index.css has new utility classes for neon pulse, glass sidebar, etc
docker-compose.yml has NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0 and no healthcheck
pnpm run build succeeds without type errors
verification: Run pnpm run typecheck from workspace root and confirm no errors
Run pnpm run build from workspace root and confirm successful build
Verify docker-compose.yml contains NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0 and does not contain 'healthcheck'
findings: Build requires PORT=3000 BASE_PATH=/ env vars (pre-existing issue with mockup-sandbox). Frontend typecheck and build both pass cleanly. docker-compose.yml was already correct (has NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0, no healthcheck). All acceptance criteria met.
